# Implementation Plan: WordPress DB Migration Agent

**Branch**: `aiops/wp-db-migration-agent` | **Date**: 2026-10-13 | **Spec**: [spec.md](./spec.md)

**Input**: Feature specification from `.github/specs/024-wp-db-migration-agent/spec.md`

## Summary

Add a portable agent, `agents/wp-db-migration-agent/`, that moves WordPress databases between
MySQL hosts and WordPress Studio local sites. It ships three skills: a sanitiser that makes MySQL
exports importable into Studio (skill 1, from the prompt proven on 2026-10-13), a pre-flight check
for Studio phpMyAdmin exports going to staging or live (skill 2), and a serialisation-safe site URL
replacement (skill 3). Byte-level work is done by one dependency-free Node script with Jest tests,
so results never depend on an AI re-deriving escape rules. URL replacement delegates to WP-CLI
`search-replace` through Studio. The agent is exposed to Claude Code through the generated thin
definition in `.claude/agents/`.

## Technical Context

**Language/Version**: Node.js 20+ (CommonJS, built-ins only: `fs`, `path`, `zlib`, `crypto`)

**Primary Dependencies**: None at runtime. WP-CLI through `studio wp` (bundled with Studio) for URL
replacement. Jest (repository root dev dependency) for tests.

**Storage**: Files only. Input SQL export is read; new files are written beside it.

**Testing**: Jest unit tests against small byte fixtures under the agent's `tests/fixtures/`;
repository validators (`validate:agents`, `validate:skills`, `lint:md`).

**Target Platform**: macOS developer machines running WordPress Studio 1.24+ (SQLite Database
Integration 3.x); any OS with Node 20 for the script.

**Project Type**: Agent package (specification + skills + CLI script).

**Performance Goals**: Process a 100 MB dump in under 30 seconds; stream large files rather than
loading them whole where the transform allows.

**Constraints**: Byte-exact output outside the intended edits; never modify input; no data rows or
personal data printed; no network access; no remote database access.

**Scale/Scope**: Dumps from a few MB to several GB; single-site and multisite WordPress.

## Constitution Check

*GATE: Must pass before Phase 0 research. Re-check after Phase 1 design.*

| Principle | Status | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| I. Organisation-wide governance | Pass | Agent lives in this repository's portable `agents/` tree. |
| II. Locked files | Pass | No change to labels, issue types or templates. |
| III. Asset boundaries | Pass | Agent and skills under `agents/`; spec under `.github/specs/`; generated `.claude/agents/` thin definition is a platform-required location already used by changelog-agent. |
| IV. Technology-agnostic central guidance | Pass | WordPress-specific content stays inside a WordPress-specific agent, as with `wp-config-agent`; no central guidance changes. |
| V/VIII. Branch naming | Pass | `aiops/wp-db-migration-agent`, validated. |
| VI. UK English, security | Pass | UK English throughout; read-only by default; no credentials handled; destructive or remote actions are the user's. |
| VII. Specification quality | Pass | Spec checklist complete, no clarification markers. |
| IX. Changelog compliance | Pass | Root `CHANGELOG.md` entry under `[Unreleased]` plus the agent's own `CHANGELOG.md`. |
| X. Automated validation | Pass | Jest tests plus existing validators run in CI. |

Post-design re-check: unchanged, all pass.

### Source Code (repository root)

```text
agents/wp-db-migration-agent/
├── wp-db-migration.agent.md        # Canonical specification (agent frontmatter)
├── AGENT.md                        # Agent entry point
├── README.md                       # Team-facing usage guide
├── CHANGELOG.md                    # Agent version history
├── package.json                    # Scripts: test, sql-tool
├── lib/
│   └── sql-tool.cjs                # sanitise | preflight | site-urls subcommands
├── skills/
│   ├── mysql-to-studio-sanitiser/SKILL.md   # Skill 1 (the proven prompt)
│   ├── studio-export-preflight/SKILL.md     # Skill 2
│   └── wp-url-replacement/SKILL.md          # Skill 3
└── tests/
    ├── fixtures/                   # Small synthetic dumps (no real data)
    └── unit/
        └── sql-tool.test.js

.claude/agents/wp-db-migration-agent.md   # Generated by scripts/agents/generate-agent-defs.cjs
scripts/agents/generate-agent-defs.cjs    # Add the new agent to AGENTS list
agents/README.md                          # Index entry
CHANGELOG.md                              # [Unreleased] entry
```

**Structure Decision**: Follow the changelog-agent layout (spec 016), the most recent agent brought
into line with spec 014. `config/` (spec 014 FR-002) is omitted because the agent has no
configuration; this matches changelog-agent. Skills are agent-local until a second consumer
appears.
